title: Beyond Old Boys' Clubs: Financial Analysts' Utliization of Professional Connections

scopes.description: Complete author-documented workflow for preparing CIQ experience and transcript measures, constructing analyst/executive connections and running the supplied analyses.

requirements.description: Prepared CRSP/Compustat quarterly panel CRSP_Compustat.dta. The driver constructs quarterly firm controls from dates, CRSP identifiers and Compustat fundamentals, then merges those controls into the forecast sample. Required fields include datadate, lpermno, cusip, tic, gvkey, sic, fyear, CRSP/Compustat identifiers, and the quarterly measures used in the code. Period/history: The sample forecast period is 2004–2022; quarterly input/history beyond the estimation sample is not established.

issues.description: The datasheet and readmes describe investor-conference, earnings-call and analyst-linkage stages, while the frozen work-item source registration does not provide screened text for the inventoried HTML and referenced Python program bodies. Their detailed field handoffs and production steps remain unreviewed; this is a coverage limit, not evidence that the code or outputs are absent.

The Stata driver requires ciq_career_indicators.dta and fields including gvkey_collector_after, but the registered SAS sources visibly write CIQ_FAexperience.dta and analyst linkage CSVs. The referenced linktable_02 Python source and exact producer from those outputs to the Stata input are not registered, so this handoff and the full schema remain unresolved.

The Stata source contains an additional join by execid and a transcriptid merge whose exact input contracts are not established in the registered review. The README names exec_boardex_link.dta, while the transcriptid input identity remains unresolved; nwords_qn is consumed after that merge.

actions.description: Obtain the author-named Stata inputs and update workbooks, then verify schemas, join keys and date/history coverage before running the driver.
steps: Locate the exact author-prepared files named in the Stata readme, including four gender updates, both conference workbooks, CRSP/Compustat and price panels, I/B/E/S inputs, DGTW returns, 13F ownership and the all-star panel.
For each file, record physical path, native fields, join keys and date coverage; verify 2004–2022 sample coverage and any pre-sample experience or lag history separately.
Confirm necessary commercial subscriptions described in the datasheet where a source product must be reacquired, and retain the authors' preparation/filtering choices.

If rebuilding from native products, treat COMP.FUNDQ plus CRSP.CCMXPF_LINKTABLE and daily CRSP.DSF plus monthly CRSP.MSF as joint candidates; treat I/B/E/S DET_EPSUS/DETU_EPSUS and TFN.S34 as product candidates only. Preserve unresolved annual/horizon filters, all-time history, panel/link construction, Top10InstOwn and BoardEx matching until the author contract is documented.
Exact IBES.REC/RECS and ccmlink_qtr_202212 catalog lookups returned no matching leaves; request the author product identity or an exact supported route without inferring data or licensing absence.
validation: Probe bounded metadata on exact files and compare every consumed field/key against code; document full date/history coverage separately because one-row probes cannot establish it.
Do not credit any candidate table as a complete input until exact native keys/fields, selection rules and required history have been verified.

actions.description: Provide the CIQ/WRDS source tables and manual mapping files read by the registered SAS preparation sources.
steps: Obtain 02_ANALYSPERSONID_LINK.csv and 01_brokers_matched_20230507.csv with the authors' mapping rules.
For each CIQ/WRDS table, record exact physical file, native columns and extraction period; include the CIQ country/geography map and ccmlink_qtr_202212 input named by the SAS source.
Compare fields, keys and year coverage across repeated uses in both SAS sources before treating one table as a complete input.
validation: Use bounded one-row probes only on exact catalog-listed files under the approved root; verify manually supplied CSV headers and keys without executing study code.

actions.description: Resolve how the registered CIQ preparation outputs produce the Stata career-indicator input.
steps: Obtain a registered, screened source view for linktable_02_link_with_ibes_analys.py and identify the exact writer for ciq_career_indicators.dta.
Record the complete output schema, analyst-ID mapping, GVKEY career fields and date/history selection linking the SAS outputs to the Stata merge.
validation: Confirm a source-backed producer chain and compare each Stata-consumed field/key with a bounded metadata probe of the exact prepared input.

actions.description: Complete the registered-source review for the conference and earnings-call preparation branches.
steps: Register screened text views for the inventoried investor-conference and earnings-call HTML programs and the referenced Python linkage program.
Trace their exact data inputs, outputs and handoffs into the Stata datasets, retaining any remaining unregistered source or handoff gap explicitly.
validation: Confirm each source has an exact registered package path and hash before relying on its code or treating the workflow as closed.

actions.description: Resolve the additional Stata inputs keyed by executive or transcript IDs.
steps: Provide exec_boardex_link.dta and its director/executive mapping fields, and identify the transcriptid-keyed input that supplies nwords_qn.
For both inputs, document exact file identity, full join keys and expected coverage.
The broad BoardEx lookup found local region-specific profile-detail candidates; obtain the authors’ exact executive/director link file or documented mapping process before substitution.
validation: Verify each input's native fields against the Stata join/merge statements with a bounded metadata check.

actions.description: Resolve the three Stata add-ons used by the driver but not found by the bounded environment checks.
steps: Install or configure rangejoin, xfill and winsor2 for Stata 18 from an approved Stata package source.
validation: Rerun bounded software metadata checks for each exact command and record installed versions/locations.

actions.description: Establish the SAS runtime status for the registered preparation sources after input requirements are assembled.
steps: Confirm an authorized SAS 9.4 runtime and required library configuration through the project's approved operational process.
validation: Record a supported runtime/version and library-availability check before any later author-code run; this assessment did not start SAS.

actions.description: Configure the Stata input and output directories after the named data inputs are present.
steps: Set the driver's inpath/outpath macros to accessible directories containing verified author inputs and writable outputs while preserving expected basenames.
Resolve every use/import/merge target to one exact prepared file before attempting the driver.
validation: Check path resolution for each required source file and confirm the output directory is writable.

review_notes: Full-pipeline scope uses the registered Stata driver and both registered SAS preparation sources; inventoried HTML bodies and the README-referenced Python source remain outside the registered text-source set.

Local CIQ catalog candidates remain unverified without bounded data probes. Catalog hits do not establish the author-prepared career, transcript or country-map contracts.
